form.label: Overview
form.description: This dashboard gives you an at-a-glance view of Claude Desktop's overall health and activity. To dig into the details, open one of the focused dashboards — Desktop, MCP, Web, or Cowork.

search.query: | metadata type=hosts index=claude | sort host | fields host
`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ (`claude_sourcetype_main` OR `claude_sourcetype_mcp` OR `claude_sourcetype_web` OR `claude_sourcetype_cowork`) | stats count

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ (`claude_sourcetype_main` OR `claude_sourcetype_web` OR `claude_sourcetype_mcp`) | eval level=lower(coalesce(log_level, log_level_b)) | where level="error" | stats count
`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ (`claude_sourcetype_main` OR `claude_sourcetype_web`) | eval level=lower(log_level) | where level="warn" | stats count

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ sourcetype=_json source=*claude_desktop_config.json | dedup _raw | sort - _time | head 1 | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<mcp_server>[^\"]+)\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"(?:command|url|type)\"" | stats dc(mcp_server) as registered

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ `claude_sourcetype_mcp` "Message from client" "method=\"tools/call\"" | rex field=_raw "\[(?<srv>[a-z0-9-]+)\]" | rex field=_raw "id=(?<rpc_id>\d+)" | bucket _time span=1h | stats count by srv rpc_id _time | stats count as tool_calls
`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ `claude_sourcetype_cowork` "[VM] Module loaded successfully" | stats count

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ (`claude_sourcetype_main` OR `claude_sourcetype_mcp` OR `claude_sourcetype_web` OR `claude_sourcetype_cowork`) | eval area=case( sourcetype="claude:desktop:main" OR sourcetype="claude:3p:desktop:main", "desktop", sourcetype="claude:desktop:mcp" OR sourcetype="claude:3p:desktop:mcp", "mcp", sourcetype="claude:desktop:web" OR sourcetype="claude:3p:desktop:web", "web", sourcetype="claude:desktop:cowork" OR sourcetype="claude:3p:desktop:cowork", "cowork", true(), "other") | timechart span=1h count by area

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ (`claude_sourcetype_main` OR `claude_sourcetype_web` OR `claude_sourcetype_mcp`) | eval level=lower(coalesce(log_level, log_level_b)) | where level="error" OR level="warn" | timechart span=1h count by level

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ `claude_sourcetype_main` | where lower(log_level)="error" OR lower(log_level)="warn" | eval component=coalesce(component, "(none)") | stats count by component | sort - count | head 10

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ sourcetype=_json source=*claude_desktop_config.json | dedup _raw | sort - _time | head 1 | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<mcp_server>[^\"]+)\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"(?:command|url|type)\"" | fields mcp_server | mvexpand mcp_server | table mcp_server
